items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Extreme Heat Warning, dangerously hot conditions
with high temperatures in the upper 90s to 105 with very warm
nights with low temperatures in the lower to mid 70s expected. For
the Wind Advisory, east winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Valleys.

* WHEN...For the Extreme Heat Warning, until 8 PM PDT Thursday. For
the Wind Advisory, from 6 AM to 6 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result. Heat
related illnesses increase significantly during extreme heat
events.
